$comment: Evidence the AI Quality Gate reads for a PR's HEAD commit (docs/governance/ai-engineering-pipeline.md §8). `checks` are check runs, `statuses` commit statuses. kind: build | tests | contract | sonar | security. skippedOk: a skipped run counts as passed (pr-contract skips drafts). A missing or running required item makes the verdict INCONCLUSIVE; a failed one blocks, except a Sonar gate whose only failed conditions are new-code coverage (COVERAGE_WARNING).
